title: Anyone been to a flooded hotel?
content: I dreamt of a flooded trailer park district last night that felt like it was just outside of town of the main mall/waterpark/train station area. Lots of wierd people. It had an above water pathway that led into a place that felt like a mix between a hotel and an art museum. I entered into a catwalk just above a retro Japanese giftshop/welcome center combo area. Calm bright lights there. To the left was a two story height atrium hallway with a few paintings on the walls, with piles of Legos on the ground and Asian workmen panicking over them for some reason. The building felt like an odd mix of 70s college/ancient native American Adobe house/90s Japan. And the floors were covered in water logged orange carpeting. One section even had a thin waterfall coming out of the roof that reflected water like a mirror.
